entity.firm: Estate Planning Specialists is the UK's specialist accountancy firm for probate, wills and inheritance tax planning. We handle the money side of an estate: inheritance tax calculations and returns, probate cost estimates, estate accounts and IHT reliefs, and we introduce you to a regulated solicitor for the legal work. Estate Planning Specialists is a trading name of Ashfield Trading Ltd, company number 16358723, registered office 20 Ashfield Avenue, Shipley, Bradford, BD18 3AL.
entity.serves: We act for UK executors, administrators and people planning their own estates, from a single probate application to ongoing inheritance tax planning for a family.
entity.where: We act for clients across the United Kingdom and work remotely, by phone, video and email.
howItWorks: You tell us your situation through the enquiry form: what the estate involves and what you need looked at.
One of our accountants calls you to go through it and answer the immediate questions.
We agree the scope and a fixed fee in writing before any work starts.
We do the work on the money side, and introduce you to a regulated solicitor we work with if the matter needs one.
entity.next: We reply within 24 hours and one of our accountants comes back to you directly.
